column1: # Book 5 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 5.52, 5.62 suerit, solere = was wont; "was used to" reads as a passive.
# 5.129 aequore salso = the salt sea; "the deep sea" was carried over from 3.785, where the Latin has aequore in alto.

column2: Especially since he was wont to give, well and divinely,
but that images are wont to deceive the mind in sleep
in the salt sea, nor can fish live in the fields,
